title: Pre-register checkpoint regression gate
action_policy: Report action-name, exact-action, and click-in-bounds deltas separately across all suites. Action improvement is expected but is not allowed to conceal a hard perception regression.
decision_policy: Stop before the next stage only on hard regression. Otherwise continue and preserve metric-level warnings, matching the user's instruction to continue unless regression occurs.
anti_post_hoc_note: This amendment was committed while the first SFT checkpoint was still training and before any SFT evaluation receipt existed.
